channel.title: Applications on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Applications on KubeSphere

item.title: Install Apps from the App Store
item.description: This section describes how to install apps from the KubeSphere platform’s App Store. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the App Instance Creation permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps In the upper right corner of the page, click , and then click App Store. In the App Store, click the app template you want to use, and then click Deploy in the upper right corner.

item.title: Install an App from an App Template
item.description: This section describes how to install an app from an app template in a workspace or a third-party app repository. Note To use app templates in a workspace, you need to install and enable the "KubeSphere App Store Management" extension. After installation, the App Templates option will appear under the App Management menu of the workspace. Then workspace members with relevant permissions can create app templates for the workspace.

item.title: View Application List
item.description: This section describes how to view the application list. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Instance View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Instance View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Application Workloads > Applications in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Details of Template-Based Application
item.description: This section describes how to view details of a template-based application. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Instance View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Instance View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Application Workloads > Applications in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit App Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit app information. You can edit the alias and description of an app. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of an already created app. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the App Instance Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has App Instance Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Edit App Settings
item.description: This section describes how to edit the settings of a created app. You can also edit app settings when creating an app. For more information, see Install an App from the App Store and Install an App Using an App Template. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the App Instance Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles.

item.title: Delete an Application
item.description: This section describes how to delete an application. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Instance Deletion permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Delete a Single Application Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Instance Deletion permissions and enter your workspace. Click Application Workloads > Applications in the left navigation pane.
